- The reconciling gate `scripts/check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs` (+234, wired as `check:skill-top-level-keys` in `package.json` and as a required step in `lint.yml`'s `Type Check · source gates` beside `check:skill-compatibility`): reads the enumeration out of the anchored paragraph and the keys of `COMPOSE_KEY_DISPOSITIONS` out of `stack.zod.ts` SOURCE TEXT (the job precedes the build), fails on the symmetric difference in both directions (`[missing]` / `[phantom]` / `[duplicate]`, exit 1), and refuses to run clean on a broken read (anchor absent, table absent, a lit control under 40 keys, an unreadable path, a stale exclusion — exit 2, never 0). The seat agrees with A on all four axes: nobody authors either (measured: `compile.ts` writes `runtimeModule`; `viewItems` is `z.never`; zero hits under `examples/`), the exclusion is witnessed against the spec's own declaration so it cannot outlive its reason, listing `viewItems` would teach the very class-(c) trap this card is about, and the ratchet has 3 tokens of headroom.
